title: ravensara pervillei
intro: Ravensara pervillei, commonly known as Ravensara or Ratanjot, is a plant species native to Madagascar, belonging to the family Lauraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it beneficial for relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as soothing skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Ravensara pervillei are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and promote a sense of calm, which may contribute to its use in aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of Ravensara pervillei include essential oils rich in camphene, bornyl acetate, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
